summary: Focused Phase 1 implementation plan for the HireNestOS Requirement Sharing & WhatsApp Distribution flow (7-step flow: Requirement Received -> Approved -> Click Share Requirement [Vendor Sharing vs Direct Candidates] -> Choose Sharing Method [WhatsApp / Copy Link / In-app Feed] -> Record Recipient & Sharing Activity -> Recipient Responds -> Track Responses through Screening, Interview & Placement).
